status: DRAFT for senior review. Maps demand-mined unassessed terms to candidate lexicon rows of kind whole_food for unconditioned Tier 1 clauses of FAO 2019 Table 1 Group 1 (legumes and leafy vegetables). Commodity datasets supply names only; never decides a NOVA group.

clause.where: FAO 2019 (Monteiro et al., Ultra-processed foods, diet quality, and health using the NOVA classification system), Table 1, Group 1 examples, p. 11
clause.unconditioned: FAO Table 1 Group 1 unconditioned examples: 'legumes such as beans, lentils, and chickpeas' and 'Fresh, squeezed, chilled, frozen, or dried fruit and leafy and root vegetables'.

category_gate.food_category: Legumes and Legume Products / Vegetables and Vegetable Products
category_gate.note: Only plain, raw/dry single commodities in Legumes and Legume Products or Vegetables and Vegetable Products categories are mapped.

named_terms.why: The clause explicitly names 'beans' ('legumes such as beans, lentils, and chickpeas').

covered_forms.cabbage: Fresh, squeezed, chilled, frozen, or dried fruit and leafy and root vegetables (cabbage is a leafy vegetable).

label_bound_clauses.note: Conditioned clauses stay label-bound: no commodity name passes automatically. Conditioned categories are never ACCEPTed by any rule in this file.

clauses.Nut and Seed Products: tree and ground nuts and other oily seeds (with no added salt or sugar)
clauses.Fruits and Fruit Juices: fresh or pasteurized fruit or vegetable juices (with no added sugar, sweeteners or flavours)
clauses.Cereal Grains and Pasta: grits, flakes or flour made from corn, wheat, oats, or cassava
